counterfactual_missing_items: normal biventricular function without significant valvular lesions
sinus rhythm at 72 beats per minute
decisive_items: prolonged His-ventricular (HV) interval of 75 milliseconds on first conducted beat, extending to 277 milliseconds on second conducted beat
PR interval prolongs between first and second conducted beats
Some P waves do not conduct to ventricles
response.rationale: C1 is the most specific and detailed diagnosis, with a clear description of the prolonged His-ventricular interval, which is a characteristic feature of Mobitz Type II Second-Degree AV Block. R5 is a close second, but it lacks the specificity of C1.

rejected.why: R2 is too narrow, only accounting for the right bundle branch block, but not the overall clinical picture.
R6 is not supported by the ECG findings, which do not show abnormal sinus node function characteristic of Sick Sinus Syndrome.
